comments.body: looks like the change is made in this pr. https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/1804

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body:
here is the call flow difference between the original code and sonic code.
```
new flow:

_nss_tacplus_getpwnam_r
lookup_tacacs_user
got_tacacs_user
lookup_user_pw
  -> lookup_pw_local (read-only)
  -> create_and_modify_local_user (try to call usermod and causing the lockup issue)
  -> lookup_pw_local

old flow:

_nss_tacplus_getpwnam_r
lookup_tacacs_user
got_tacacs_user
  -> find_pw_userpriv (read-only)
```

**- Why I did it**
fix #6617 

[tacacs]: do not modify local user if there is no priviledge
    
    check the uid before modify local user account.
    
    when run sudo, the process the invoke nss_tacplus library
    does not have priviledge to modify the user profile, and
    will generate below error messages:
    
        user_rw@sonic:~$ sudo bash
        usermod: Permission denied.
        usermod: cannot lock /etc/passwd; try again later.
        usermod: Permission denied.
        usermod: cannot lock /etc/passwd; try again later.

**- How I did it**
check uid first, and skip modify local user if uid is not root

**- How to verify it**
manually verify run sudo bash.
